3376 men {mane}

原形字; TDNT - 4:638,591; 陽性名詞

欽定本 - month 18; 18

1) 一個月
2) 新月 (每個月的第一天, 當新月出現時是希伯來人的慶典時期) (#加 4:10|)
record.edic_text:
3376 men {mane}

a primary word; TDNT - 4:638,591; n m

AV - month 18; 18

1) a month
2) the time of the new moon, new moon (the first day of each month,
   when the new moon appeared was a festival among the Hebrews)
